cdp-app.notes: Serve is package.json:30-31 'electron-dev' verbatim, with the three levers the project ALREADY reads: CYBOFLOW_VITE_PORT (frontend/vite.config.ts:12, strictPort:true at :15), CYBOFLOW_CDP_PORT (package.json:31 -> --remote-debugging-port), CYBOFLOW_DIR (main/src/utils/cyboflowDirectory.ts:89). CYBOFLOW_DIR is mandatory, not hygiene: the single-instance lock is keyed on the userData path under it (main/src/index.ts:592-611), so without it this instance silently loses to the developer's own pnpm dev. No 'web' entry: the renderer cannot bootstrap standalone without preload-injected electronTRPC (docs/VISUAL-VERIFICATION-SETUP.md:27-32). Attestation is the launch-token channel (see RUNG 2 APPLIED below); it is NOT tied to package.json version, so a release cannot invalidate it. PROVEN-ROUND LANDMINES (round 1, 2026-08-06): (1) 'env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE' is LOAD-BEARING, not hygiene -- the verification agent is itself hosted inside Electron, so ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 is INHERITED into serve; 'electron .' then runs as plain node and dies with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading getAppPath)', and concurrently reports only 'exited with code 1'. (2) The bundled driver require('playwright') is MODULE_NOT_FOUND from app.asar.unpacked, and its catch MASKS this as 'CDP endpoint not reachable on port N' even when the app is healthy and curl answers on that port. Workaround: export NODE_PATH=<snapshot>/node_modules before invoking $VERIFY_DRIVER. Do NOT read that message as a serve failure without first curling the CDP port. SERVE-IDENTITY BINDING (round 2, PROVEN BY MEASUREMENT): the leading 'unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;' is load-bearing TWICE OVER. (a) It clears the var the Electron-hosted agent inherits, without which 'electron .' runs as plain node and dies on app.getAppPath. (b) The ';' keeps /bin/sh as the detached process-GROUP LEADER. A serve cmd that is a single simple command -- including the plain 'CYBOFLOW_DIR=... pnpm run electron-dev' form, and any 'env -u ...' prefix -- is EXEC-OPTIMIZED by sh, so the leader's argv becomes 'node .../pnpm run electron-dev' and no longer carries the pinned string; serveCommandMatches (verificationAgentRunner.ts:1130) then fails with 'a substitute or a wrapper was started instead of the deliverable'. Measured on this host: simple-command forms do NOT bind; this compound form DOES. Do not 'simplify' this command back to a single statement. RUNG 2 APPLIED (2026-08-06, approved at the approve-runbook gate and at handover): serve now injects CYBOFLOW_VERIFY_TOKEN, which main/src/preload.ts exposes as window.__CYBOFLOW_VERIFY__.token and main/src/index.ts turns into a distinguishing OS window title. Both are absent unless the launcher sets the var, so a developer's own pnpm dev instance can no longer satisfy either attestation. This REPLACES the version-pinned electronAPI.getAppVersion()/'0.2.0' channel, which matched any running instance AND silently broke on every version bump; 'expected' is now a constant that no release invalidates.

native-screen.notes: Same serve as cdp-app: the OS chrome only exists while the app runs. attach:'cdp' is kept deliberately even though this modality captures via peekaboo, because it sets VERIFY_DRIVER_ATTACH_ONLY (verificationAgentRunner.ts:2123) and stops the driver launching a blank chromium that would screenshot the wrong surface. app='Electron', not 'Cyboflow': a pnpm dev launch is UNPACKAGED, so the OS app name is Electron (docs/VISUAL-VERIFICATION-SETUP.md:87). titlePattern matches the verify-only title set at main/src/index.ts createWindow() (see RUNG 2 APPLIED below), NOT the page <title>, whose mirroring is pinned off for verify launches. window-identity remains the weakest KIND of channel by contract, but it now discriminates: an ordinary pnpm dev window keeps the plain 'Cyboflow' title and cannot match. SERVE-IDENTITY BINDING (round 2, PROVEN BY MEASUREMENT): the leading 'unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;' is load-bearing TWICE OVER. (a) It clears the var the Electron-hosted agent inherits, without which 'electron .' runs as plain node and dies on app.getAppPath. (b) The ';' keeps /bin/sh as the detached process-GROUP LEADER. A serve cmd that is a single simple command -- including the plain 'CYBOFLOW_DIR=... pnpm run electron-dev' form, and any 'env -u ...' prefix -- is EXEC-OPTIMIZED by sh, so the leader's argv becomes 'node .../pnpm run electron-dev' and no longer carries the pinned string; serveCommandMatches (verificationAgentRunner.ts:1130) then fails with 'a substitute or a wrapper was started instead of the deliverable'. Measured on this host: simple-command forms do NOT bind; this compound form DOES. Do not 'simplify' this command back to a single statement. RUNG 2 APPLIED (2026-08-06, approved at the approve-runbook gate and at handover): serve now injects CYBOFLOW_VERIFY_TOKEN, which main/src/preload.ts exposes as window.__CYBOFLOW_VERIFY__.token and main/src/index.ts turns into a distinguishing OS window title. Both are absent unless the launcher sets the var, so a developer's own pnpm dev instance can no longer satisfy either attestation. This REPLACES titlePattern '^Cyboflow', which round 1 (vr_457be558) PROVED unresolvable: peekaboo list windows --app Electron exits 1 with 'Ambiguous application identifier: Electron' whenever a second unpackaged Electron runs, and on this host one did (the shiny-panda-20260803 worktree). Both observable behaviors passed; only identity failed. APP SELECTOR IS A BUNDLE ID, NOT A NAME (measured on this host 2026-08-06, do not 'simplify' back to 'Electron'): peekaboo resolves --app by FUZZY match over name AND bundle id, so 'Electron' matched com.superhuman.electron (Superhuman) while cyboflow was not even running, and matched BOTH whenever two Electron-family apps were live -- exiting 1 with 'Ambiguous application identifier: Electron' before any title comparison happens. A bundle id resolves exactly ('--app com.superhuman.electron' returns only Superhuman; '--app com.github.Electron' returns a clean 'not running' when it is not). com.github.Electron is CFBundleIdentifier of node_modules/.pnpm/electron@37.6.0/.../Electron.app, which is what an unpackaged pnpm dev launches. RESIDUAL: two concurrent com.github.Electron instances (two worktrees both running pnpm dev) may still be ambiguous at the app-resolution step; the titlePattern discriminates the WINDOW but cannot rescue a failed APP lookup. That residual is a driver-side limitation, filed as a finding.

levers.notes: cdpPortFlag is what 'electron .' receives (package.json:31); the runbook sets it indirectly via CYBOFLOW_CDP_PORT, which that script interpolates. dataDirEnv is CYBOFLOW_DIR and NOT --user-data-dir: the single-instance lock keys on the userData path derived from CYBOFLOW_DIR (main/src/index.ts:592-611), so --user-data-dir alone does not break the singleton.
